Package game.actors

Class GoldenBeetle

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actors.Actor
game.actors.GoldenBeetle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Speaker, Consumable, Reproducible
public class GoldenBeetle extends Actor implements Consumable, Reproducible, Speaker
GoldenBeetle with wandering behaviour and a follow behaviour to follow the player. It can also lay eggs and can be consumed for health and runes.
